name: Cityscapes
summary: 覆盖欧洲城市街景的驾驶图像与短时序数据集，提供精细像素语义、实例及深度相关信息，广泛用于未来语义预测和城市视觉世界建模。
summaryEn: An urban-driving dataset from European cities with short sequences and fine semantic and instance annotations, widely used for future semantic prediction.
scale: 5K finely annotated frames · 20K coarse frames · 50 cities
scaleZh: 5,000 帧精细标注 · 2 万帧粗标注 · 50 座城市
organizations: Daimler and Max Planck Institute for Informatics
organizationsZh: 戴姆勒、马克斯·普朗克信息学研究所
license: Cityscapes License; non-commercial research restrictions apply
licenseZh: 适用 Cityscapes 许可；包含非商业研究限制
wmNote: 密集语义与时序上下文适合预测研究，但传感器种类和直接控制信息有限。
wmNoteEn: Dense semantics and temporal context support prediction, though sensing and direct controls are limited.
